rules.title: Underground water tank / borewell in North
rules.explanation: Traditional Vastu generally favours underground water sources in the North or North-East.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for underground water tank / borewell placement.
rules.architectural_note: Any tank relocation requires qualified civil, plumbing and waterproofing advice.
rules.existing_home_note: Keep the tank hygienic, sealed and regularly maintained; do not rely on symbolic remedies for safety issues.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
